answer: Falcon stoop-table bond: each identity registers a falcon at an umber-painted vertex perch. Each epoch the falcon stoops from its vertex to an umber-marked lure; auditors recompute it from a public stoop table. Over 3% off, or one band at two perches, burns the bond. First filing 36, kth 36+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,033,000, lock 70,000. A rented-falcon ring fails: one bird, one stoop. Honest keepers pay 36 once, reclaim it after a clean epoch.
